facts.text: The walk from the hotel to King Abdul Aziz Gate is about 870 metres along pedestrian streets, roughly 12 to 15 minutes at an easy pace.
facts.verified_from: OpenStreetMap path, measured Nov 2026, confirmed by Williams 18 Nov 2026

facts.text: This is King Abdul Aziz Gate, numbered Gate 1, on the south side of the Haram facing the Clock Tower.
facts.verified_from: OpenStreetMap node 4755914231, Nov 2026, confirmed by Williams 18 Nov 2026

facts.text: From here the route follows Al Mesial Road, a pedestrian street, most of the way to the Clock Tower plaza.
facts.verified_from: OpenStreetMap way 565570660, Nov 2026, confirmed by Williams 18 Nov 2026

facts.text: The First Ring Road crosses overhead here on a bridge, so the street runs underneath it.
facts.verified_from: OpenStreetMap ways 9544185 and 80208473, Nov 2026, confirmed by Williams 18 Nov 2026

facts.text: Two pharmacies are mapped close by: Dhiouf Makkah, just beside the route, and an Al Nahdi pharmacy a little further on.
facts.verified_from: OpenStreetMap nodes 6214483638 and 6587383192, Nov 2026, confirmed by Williams 18 Nov 2026

facts.text: There's an entrance to the food courts on the third floor of the Abraj Al Bait (Clock Tower) complex just ahead.
facts.verified_from: OpenStreetMap node 7530037908, Nov 2026, confirmed by Williams 18 Nov 2026

facts.text: Flights of steps are mapped to the west of here, towards Hamza Ibn Abdul Mutalib Street, so stay on the plaza level.
facts.verified_from: OpenStreetMap ways 563955380 and 563955381, Nov 2026, confirmed by Williams 18 Nov 2026

facts.text: Ajyad Emergency Hospital is mapped about 170 metres to the east.
facts.verified_from: OpenStreetMap node 5076188152, Nov 2026, confirmed by Williams 18 Nov 2026

facts.text: A prayer hall inside the Abraj Al Bait complex is about 110 metres to the south-east.
facts.verified_from: OpenStreetMap node 5923016911, Nov 2026, confirmed by Williams 18 Nov 2026

facts.text: King Abdul Aziz Gate is straight ahead, about 40 metres away.
facts.verified_from: OpenStreetMap path, measured Nov 2026, confirmed by Williams 18 Nov 2026
